1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.question: Do you know the origin, lineage, and authenticity of private datasets used for fine-tuning, training, or RAG embeddings?
1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.framework_mapping: ISO 42001 (A.8.2.1), NIST AI RMF (GOVERN 1.2), SAIF Pillar 1
1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.rationale: Prevents training data poisoning and lineage corruption in active prompt and retrieval perimeters.

1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.question: Are fine-tuning and embedding pipelines equipped with centralized audit logs recording all data access and modifications?
1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.rationale: Ensures end-to-end traceability of training data pipelines and regulatory compliance.

1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.question: Is an enterprise data classification schema (e.g., Public, Internal, Confidential, Restricted) mapped to your AI data catalog?
1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.rationale: Guides Cloud DLP inline masking and access control policies.

1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.question: Do you strictly isolate untrusted third-party data from internal knowledge bases to prevent RAG context poisoning?
1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.rationale: Mixing data tiers without logical boundaries is the #1 vulnerability for indirect prompt injection in RAG.

1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.question: Is Cloud DLP or an equivalent engine actively masking PII (e.g., CPF, SSN, Credit Cards, API Keys) prior to model ingestion?
1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.rationale: Prevents sensitive credentials or consumer privacy data from leaking into foundation model context windows.

1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.question: Are Vector Databases (e.g., Vertex AI Vector Search, Pinecone, pgvector) enforcing tenant-level access control and row-level security?
1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.rationale: Prevents cross-tenant data leakage where User A retrieves private embedding vectors belonging to User B.

1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.question: Do you validate the authenticity and integrity of synthetic data generated by LLMs before using it in downstream training?
1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.rationale: Avoids model collapse and bias amplification caused by recursive synthetic data feedback loops.

1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.question: Are user consent and data retention terms explicitly tracked and enforced for all conversation histories stored in backend caches?
1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.rationale: Ensures compliance with global data subject deletion and opt-out requests.

1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.question: Do you have automated routines to detect and purge memorized training secrets (e.g., API keys, passwords) from customized weights?
1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.rationale: Neural networks can inadvertently memorize training tokens and reproduce them verbatim when prompted.

1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.question: Are data ingestion connectors (e.g., GCS buckets, BigQuery, AWS S3) validated for TLS 1.3 encryption in transit?
1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.rationale: Prevents man-in-the-middle interception during high-throughput RAG document chunking.

1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.question: Is chunked RAG document metadata (author, classification, timestamp) cryptographically signed or tamper-evident?
1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.rationale: Prevents unauthorized modification of document relevance scores or injected headers.

1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.question: Do you enforce data residency and geographic sovereignty boundaries (e.g., EU, US, Brazil) for AI training and inference?
1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.rationale: Prevents cross-border data transfer violations for regulated healthcare and financial data.

1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.question: Are embedding caches (e.g., Redis, Memorystore) encrypted at rest with dedicated customer keys?
1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.rationale: Guarantees semantic representations cannot be reconstructed from raw memory dumps.

1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.question: Do you perform statistical anomaly detection on incoming data streams to identify adversarial data drift or deliberate poisoning?
1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.rationale: Detects subtle baseline shifts intended to skew model classification boundaries over time.

1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.question: Is there a formal data de-duplication and quality verification step prior to creating vector embeddings?
1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.rationale: Reduces semantic pollution and unnecessary token consumption in retrieval pipelines.

1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.question: Are training dataset backups isolated in immutable storage with Object Versioning and Write-Once-Read-Many (WORM) policies?
1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.rationale: Protects core AI intellectual property against ransomware and malicious insider destruction.

1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.question: Do you have an automated process to scrub biometric, facial, or voice signatures from multimodal training corpora?
1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.rationale: Prevents privacy violations in multimodal Vision-Language and Speech models.

1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.question: Are data poisoning detection techniques applied during continuous active learning from user feedback?
1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.rationale: Prevents coordinated malicious user feedback from corrupting online fine-tuning.

1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.question: Is token entropy and randomness verified for session-based prompt embeddings?
1. Data Security, Lineage & Privacy (DAT.rationale: Prevents predictability in vector clustering and token sampling.

2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.question: Do you evaluate pre-trained foundation models for known supply chain vulnerabilities, licensing constraints, and verified provenance?
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.framework_mapping: ISO 42001 (A.8.3), NIST AI RMF (MAP 1.5), SLSA for AI
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.rationale: Minimizes third-party supply chain risk from malicious or untrusted neural weights.

2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.question: Do you maintain an enterprise Model Registry (e.g., Vertex AI Model Registry) with strict versioning, lineage, and approval gates?
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.rationale: Ensures reproducibility, rapid rollback, and tight governance over model release cycles.

2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.question: Are model artifact serialization formats scanned to prevent arbitrary code execution (e.g., SafeTensors enforced over unsafe Pickle files)?
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.rationale: Unsafe deserialization of PyTorch/Pickle files is a critical Remote Code Execution vector on model load.

2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.question: Do you conduct automated empirical Red Teaming and adversarial robustness testing against deployed foundation models?
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.rationale: Verifies model resilience against evasion, extraction, and jailbreaking under real attack conditions.

2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.question: Are model weight files and checkpoint binaries cryptographically signed using Sigstore or internal PKI certificates?
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.rationale: Guarantees that weights deployed to GPU inference servers have not been tampered with.

2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.question: Do you perform quantization and model compression checks to ensure security guards and safety alignments are not degraded?
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.rationale: Aggressive 4-bit/8-bit quantization can unalign safety guardrails and increase jailbreak susceptibility.

2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.question: Are fine-tuned LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) adapters scanned for trigger backdoors before merging with base weights?
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.rationale: Malicious adapters can introduce stealthy backdoors that activate only on specific trigger words.

2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.question: Do you enforce Model Card documentation specifying intended use cases, known limitations, and safety benchmark scores?
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.rationale: Provides operational transparency and prevents out-of-scope deployment.

2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.question: Is model inversion and membership inference testing conducted to ensure training data cannot be reconstructed from output probabilities?
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.rationale: Prevents attackers from determining whether specific individuals were part of the training set.

2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.question: Are third-party open-source libraries (Transformers, vLLM, LangChain, LlamaIndex) continuously scanned for CVEs in CI/CD?
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.rationale: Prevents exploitation of upstream package vulnerabilities in Python AI ecosystems.

2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.question: Do you implement watermarking or synthetic content attribution mechanisms on generative model outputs?
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.framework_mapping: EU AI Act Art. 50, NIST AI RMF (GOVERN 1.2)
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.rationale: Enables verification of synthetic media and defense against disinformation campaigns.

2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.question: Are fine-tuning hyperparameters (learning rate, epochs) locked and version-controlled to avoid adversarial overfenterpriseng?
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.rationale: Prevents catastrophic forgetting and unauthorized parameter alteration during distributed training.

2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.question: Do you maintain an isolated staging model environment for canary deployment and A/B safety validation?
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.rationale: Prevents unvetted model behavior from immediately impacting live enterprise production traffic.

2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.question: Is there a formal procedure for emergency model decommissioning and cache invalidation within 15 minutes of a critical breach?
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.rationale: Limits the blast radius if an active jailbreak or severe data leak is actively exploited in production.

2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.question: Are foundation model license agreements reviewed to ensure commercial alignment and absence of viral copyleft clauses?
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.rationale: Protects proprietary codebases and customer data from unauthorized license encumbrances.

2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.question: Do you enforce hardware-level root of trust (TPM / vTPM) on GPU/TPU nodes executing model weights?
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.rationale: Prevents low-level hypervisor and kernel compromises from inspecting decrypted weights in VRAM.

2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.question: Are reinforcement learning reward models (RLHF / RLAIF) protected from reward hacking and adversarial gradient manipulation?
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.rationale: Ensures that alignment incentives remain robust against intentional optimization subversion.

2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.question: Are model checkpoint hashes cryptographically verified against a distributed immutable ledger or transparency log?
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.framework_mapping: SLSA for AI Level 3, SAIF Pillar 1
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.rationale: Guarantees tamper-proof provenance for weights deployed across global regions.

2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.question: Do you maintain an automated rollback pipeline to instantly switch to a fallback foundation model if an anomaly is detected?
2. Model Hardening & Supply Chain Securi.rationale: Minimizes downtime and security impact during live model subversion.

3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.question: Are user input prompts validated and sanitized in real time by semantic firewalls (e.g., Model Armor, Bedrock Guardrails)?
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.framework_mapping: OWASP LLM-01, NIST AI RMF (MANAGE 2.4), SAIF Pillar 1
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.rationale: Core runtime boundary defense against direct prompt injection and multi-turn jailbreaks.

3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.question: Are model output responses filtered for toxic completions, hate speech, dangerous content, and system prompt leakage?
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.rationale: Prevents brand damage, regulatory liability, and internal instruction exfiltration.

3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.question: Do autonomous agents and tool-calling plugins enforce strict JSON schema validation on all generated parameters?
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.rationale: Prevents SQL injection, command execution, or malformed payloads caused by stochastic model outputs.

3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.question: Are tool executions that perform high-impact mutations (e.g., database writes, financial transactions, GCS deletions) protected by Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) confirmation?
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.rationale: Mitigates the catastrophic risk of autonomous agents executing destructive operations without human oversight.

3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.question: Do you enforce token quotas, rate limiting, and context window caps per user to mitigate Denial of Wallet (DoS) attacks?
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.framework_mapping: OWASP LLM-04 (Model Denial of Service), SAIF Pillar 1
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.rationale: Prevents cost exhaustion and GPU compute starvation caused by recursive or overly long prompt loops.

3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.question: Is system prompt confidentiality protected using multi-layer framing and anti-extraction instructions?
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.rationale: Prevents competitors or adversaries from extracting proprietary business logic and agent rules.

3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.question: Are agentic tools restricted by egress network firewalls to prevent Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) and data exfiltration?
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.framework_mapping: OWASP LLM-02 (Insecure Output Handling), SAIF Pillar 1
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.rationale: Prevents an LLM from fetching internal cloud metadata endpoints (e.g., 169.254.169.254) or malicious URLs.

3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.question: Do you employ canary tokens and honey-prompts in application system contexts to detect prompt leaks immediately?
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.rationale: Triggers high-fidelity security alerts when internal canary tokens appear in model completions.

3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.question: Are file uploads (PDF, DOCX, Images) processed in sandboxed environments to prevent RAG document parsing exploits?
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.rationale: Prevents malicious files from exploiting vulnerabilities in OCR and document extraction libraries.

3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.question: Do you enforce Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) output encoding when rendering LLM-generated Markdown/HTML in web applications?
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.rationale: Prevents indirect prompt injection from delivering weaponized JavaScript payloads into end-user browsers.

3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.question: Is session state and conversation context memory isolated per user to prevent cross-session contamination?
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.rationale: Guarantees that stateful multi-agent conversations do not mix chat buffers between concurrent sessions.

3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.question: Do you monitor and block recursive multi-agent communication loops that could lead to unbounded compute consumption?
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.rationale: Prevents agent-to-agent hallucinations from triggering runaway API costs and service outages.

3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.question: Are API keys and secrets stored strictly in Cloud Secret Manager rather than hardcoded in agent system prompts?
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.rationale: Hardcoding credentials in system instructions guarantees immediate leakage upon successful jailbreak.

3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.question: Do you implement continuous sentiment and hallucination scoring on customer-facing generative bot responses?
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.rationale: Detects ungrounded or misleading factual claims before they damage customer trust.

3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.question: Are multimodal image/audio inputs scanned for steganographic payloads and hidden adversarial perturbations?
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.rationale: Prevents visual jailbreaks where adversarial noise superimposed on an image bypasses text safety filters.

3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.question: Do you enforce strict CORS and CSRF protections on all inference API endpoints?
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.rationale: Prevents unauthorized web domains from generating fraudulent model inference requests.

3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.question: Are fallback mechanisms and graceful degradation policies defined when AI services experience outages or throttling?
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.rationale: Maintains core business continuity when foundational model APIs are unavailable.

3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.question: Do you enforce cryptographic signing of agent-to-agent messages in distributed multi-agent systems?
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.rationale: Prevents rogue agents from injecting malicious instructions into high-trust agent swarms.

3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.question: Are automated content moderation filters configured with deterministic fallback rules for ambiguous edge cases?
3. Application Security & Runtime Prompt.rationale: Guarantees consistent safety posture even when semantic classifiers return borderline confidence.

4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.question: Are Vertex AI Workbench and custom training compute clusters deployed with zero public IP addresses in private VPC subnets?
4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.rationale: Eliminates public internet attack surfaces on data science development and training environments.

4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.question: Are VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC) perimeters active around Cloud Storage, Vertex AI, BigQuery, and Secret Manager?
4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.rationale: Guarantees that sensitive data and model weights cannot be copied outside the organization boundary.

4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.question: Are Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) via Cloud KMS enforced on persistent disks, GCS buckets, and model endpoints?
4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.rationale: Ensures cryptographic sovereignty, key rotation, and immediate crypto-erasure capability.

4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.question: Do AI Service Accounts adhere strictly to Least Privilege IAM roles, avoiding generic Editor/Owner assignments?
4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.rationale: Limits the blast radius if an inference pod or agent container is compromised.

4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.question: Are Cloud NAT and Private Google Access configured to allow outbound package updates without public IPs?
4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.rationale: Maintains secure outbound connectivity for updates while preventing inbound unsolicited connections.

4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.question: Are Shielded VM features (Secure Boot, vTPM, Integrity Monitoring) enabled on all AI instances?
4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.rationale: Protects against bootkits, rootkits, and kernel tampering on GPU host nodes.

4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.question: Do you use Workload Identity Federation instead of long-lived service account JSON keys for CI/CD and multi-cloud?
4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.rationale: Eliminates credential leakage risks associated with static private key files.

4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.question: Is Confidential Computing (AMD SEV / Intel TDX) enabled for sensitive fine-tuning workloads in multi-tenant clouds?
4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.rationale: Encrypts data in memory (VRAM/RAM) during active model training and inference.

4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.question: Are Kubernetes clusters hosting AI workloads (GKE / EKS / AKS) protected with Binary Authorization and policy controllers?
4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.rationale: Ensures only signed and approved container images can be scheduled on GPU nodes.

4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.question: Do you enforce Organization Policies prohibiting the creation of public buckets and unattached public IPs?
4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.rationale: Automated guardrail preventing accidental exposure of AI datasets to the public internet.

4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.question: Are Private Service Connect (PSC) endpoints used to route traffic securely between VPCs and Vertex AI services?
4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.rationale: Keeps all AI inference traffic on Google's private global backbone without traversing the public internet.

4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.question: Do you enforce automatic key rotation policies (e.g., 90 days) on Cloud KMS key rings protecting AI assets?
4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.rationale: Reduces the cryptanalysis window and complies with PCI-DSS and SOC 2 requirements.

4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.question: Are SSH and RDP management ports strictly disabled or restricted via IAP (Identity-Aware Proxy) on AI nodes?
4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.rationale: Prevents brute-force access and lateral movement from compromised subnets.

4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.question: Is network traffic between distributed GPU training nodes encrypted using IPsec or WireGuard in transit?
4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.rationale: Prevents eavesdropping on intermediate gradient synchronization in multi-node clusters.

4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.question: Do you maintain segmented VPC subnets for Development, Staging, and Production AI environments?
4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.rationale: Ensures experimental models cannot accidentally touch production client databases.

4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.question: Are container registries hosting custom model serving containers scanned continuously for base image CVEs?
4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.rationale: Identifies vulnerable OS libraries (e.g., OpenSSL, glibc) before deployment to production.

4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.question: Are automated infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) templates utilized to provision all AI security perimeters?
4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.rationale: Guarantees consistent, auditable, and repeatable security baselines across all cloud projects.

4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.question: Are GPU memory scrubbing procedures enforced between multi-tenant inference job context switches?
4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.rationale: Prevents remnant activation memory leakage across isolated tenant containers sharing physical GPUs.

4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.question: Is infrastructure drift detection configured via Cloud Asset Inventory to detect unauthorized perimeter changes?
4. Infrastructure, VPC Isolation & Crypt.rationale: Alerts SecOps when firewall rules or VPC-SC boundaries are modified outside approved CI/CD pipelines.

5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.question: Are Vertex AI Data Access Logs, Model Armor telemetry, and audit trails continuously forwarded to Google SecOps (Chronicle) or SIEM?
5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.framework_mapping: ISO 42001 (A.9.2), NIST AI RMF (MEASURE 2.4), SAIF Pillar 2
5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.rationale: Ensures centralized visibility and high-fidelity forensic data for AI threat investigations.

5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.question: Do you have active threat detection rules for anomalous prompt volume spikes, token abuse, and repeated jailbreak attempts?
5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.framework_mapping: ISO 42001 (A.9.1.2), NIST AI RMF (MEASURE 3.1), MITRE ATLAS
5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.rationale: Enables Security Operations Centers (SOC) to detect and contain active exploitation campaigns.

5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.question: Are dedicated Incident Response Playbooks established specifically for AI incidents (e.g., Prompt Injection, Model Poisoning)?
5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.framework_mapping: ISO 42001 (A.9.2.1), NIST AI RMF (MANAGE 2.3), SAIF Pillar 2
5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.rationale: Ensures rapid containment, model isolation, and communication when algorithmic breaches occur.

5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.question: Do you perform periodic automated Shadow AI scans to discover unmanaged LLM containers (e.g., Ollama, vLLM on port 11434)?
5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.rationale: Eliminates unmonitored backdoors and unapproved local model deployments across cloud clusters.

5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.question: Are Security Command Center (SCC) AI Posture findings and misconfigurations actively monitored with auto-remediation triggers?
5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.rationale: Provides continuous posture evaluation and automatic remediation of misconfigured perimeters.

5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.question: Do you maintain an immutable audit log of all manual and automated prompts submitted by administrative users?
5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.rationale: Ensures non-repudiation and forensic accountability for privileged interactions.

5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.question: Are model prediction latency and error rates monitored for signs of algorithmic denial-of-service (sponge attacks)?
5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.rationale: Detects inputs engineered to maximize energy consumption and stall inference pipelines.

5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.question: Do you conduct simulated tabletop exercises with executive leadership focusing on GenAI data loss and reputational risk?
5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.rationale: Validates crisis communication, legal posture, and decision-making during severe AI failure events.

5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.question: Is prompt and completion log data retention policy compliant with data privacy regulations (e.g., auto-purge after 90 days)?
5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.rationale: Prevents indefinite accumulation of sensitive conversational records in logging storage.

5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.question: Do you use User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) to identify compromised user accounts issuing atypical AI queries?
5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.rationale: Detects compromised insider credentials attempting large-scale knowledge base exfiltration.

5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.question: Are model drift metrics (KL divergence, PSI) computed continuously to detect model performance degradation?
5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.rationale: Provides early warning when model outputs drift significantly from initial validation baselines.

5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.question: Do you participate in threat intelligence sharing communities (e.g., MITRE ATLAS, ISAC) for emerging AI attack vectors?
5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.rationale: Keeps organizational defenses updated against newly discovered universal jailbreaks.

5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.question: Are external bug bounty programs or third-party penetration tests authorized to test AI endpoints under clear Rules of Engagement?
5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.rationale: Leverages ethical security researchers to uncover edge-case prompt injection techniques.

5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.question: Do you have automated synthetic probe agents continuously validating production safety guardrails 24/7?
5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.rationale: Ensures guardrails do not experience silent failures or configuration regressions during rolling updates.

5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.question: Are automated canary requests continuously injected into production LLM endpoints to benchmark model alignment drift?
5. Security Assurance, Telemetry & Threa.rationale: Provides continuous heartbeat verification of Model Armor semantic safety filters.

6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.question: Have you established an AI Governance Committee with documented roles and responsibilities across the AI lifecycle?
6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.rationale: Eliminates accountability gaps where no specific entity governs ethical compliance or technical risk.

6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.question: Do you maintain an updated AI Software Bill of Materials (AI-BOM) tracking all models, weights, datasets, and APIs in use?
6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.framework_mapping: ISO 42001 (A.8.1), NIST AI RMF (GOVERN 1.2), SAIF Pillar 1
6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.rationale: Foundational control for managing software supply chain risks and tracking vulnerability exposure.

6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.question: Are AI-specific risk assessments (AI DPIA / Impact Assessments) mandatory before deploying any model to production?
6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.framework_mapping: ISO 42001 (Clause 6.1.2), EU AI Act Art. 9, NIST AI RMF (GOVERN 1.4)
6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.rationale: Identifies legal, ethical, and operational hazards before public or commercial release.

6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.question: Do you have documented policies outlining Acceptable Use of Generative AI tools for all employees and contractors?
6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.rationale: Prevents unapproved sharing of trade secrets or source code with public consumer AI services.

6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.question: Are models evaluated for demographic bias, disparate impact, and toxicity prior to commercial deployment?
6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.rationale: Prevents discriminatory outcomes in high-stakes decisions (e.g., credit underwriting, hiring).

6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.question: Is there a formal appeal mechanism for end users impacted by automated AI decisions (e.g., Right to Explanation)?
6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.framework_mapping: EU AI Act Art. 86, LGPD Art. 20, NIST AI RMF (GOVERN 1.3)
6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.rationale: Fulfills statutory requirements for human intervention and review in algorithmic decisions.

6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.question: Do you provide mandatory AI security and prompt injection awareness training for development and data science teams?
6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.rationale: Builds a culture of secure development across engineering and research organizations.

6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.question: Are AI vendors and third-party SaaS integrations audited for compliance with SOC 2 Type II, ISO 42001, and zero-data-retention terms?
6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.rationale: Prevents third-party SaaS vendors from training general models on confidential corporate prompts.

6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.question: Do you maintain formal records of AI system lifecycle transitions (Concept, Prototyping, Validation, Production, Sunset)?
6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.rationale: Ensures deprecated models and legacy endpoints are cleanly decommissioned without orphaned assets.

6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.question: Is there a designated AI Ethics and Safety Officer with authority to halt unsafe model deployments?
6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.rationale: Provides independent executive oversight free from direct commercial pressures.

6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.question: Are intellectual property ownership rights and patent boundaries clearly established for AI-generated assets?
6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.rationale: Protects corporate copyright and mitigates infringement claims regarding training inputs.

6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.question: Do you review and update AI security posture controls at least semi-annually to address rapidly evolving threat vectors?
6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.rationale: Maintains defense-in-depth alignment with frontier model developments and new attack methodologies.

6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.question: Is an enterprise AI Risk Register maintained and reviewed quarterly by the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)?
6. AI Governance, Compliance & Responsib.rationale: Ensures executive visibility and strategic budget allocation for AI risk mitigations.
